_about: research contribute FILE.json saves a new tree/contributions/<author>/<id>.json; never edits the snapshot. Replace the invented IDs with existing canonical IDs. families adds a spouse union with a unique id, husband/wife IDs (existing or in people in this package), status, text, sources, basis and weight (0–1; >=0.5 solid, 0.3–0.5 dashed). Add children through ordinary edges; a union alone adds no parent links. A source may list subjects, the people the paper is about: with all of them named, a fact on a living relative's card that only infers from it no longer takes it off their cards. Relationship decisions target one family union OR one parent/child pair, never both; settling a union does not settle its parent links. prior.text and prior.sources must exactly select one active fact. A new package ID is required for a later decision.
